_how_to_use: Copy the keys of "env" below into the "env" object of your own strata-<model>.json (keep the keys it already has) and restart the server. This file is an example only: it has no API key, no engine path and no arguments, and the server does not read it. See docs/SPEED_FIXES_SETUP.md, section 3a, and docs/PREFILL_PLAN.md.
_measured_on: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q4_K_XL, RTX 4080 SUPER 16 GB, 64 GB RAM, Windows 10, --resident-budget-gib 38, --prefill auto. Both sizes are tuned for a 16 GB card with this model: do not copy them to a smaller card (env.12gb.example.json).
